'''Nether Quartz''' is a {{Common}} [[Collection]] item primarily obtained in the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} and {{Zone|Abandoned Quarry}}.

== Collection ==
Collecting Nether Quartz increases the player's Nether Quartz [[Collections|collection]], which grants useful items and perks upon collecting certain amounts of Nether Quartz.
{{/Collection UI}}
{{CollectionTable|Nether Quartz}}

== Obtaining ==
=== Mining ===
'''Nether Quartz''' can be obtained from [[Mining]] {{Item|Nether Quartz Ore}} in the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}, as well as {{Item|Pure Quartz}} in the {{Zone|Abandoned Quarry}} of the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}}. The latter of which grants much more Nether Quartz, and is easier to access.

=== Mob Drops ===
{{Drop Sources}}

=== Minions ===
'''Nether Quartz''' can be obtained from {{Item|Quartz Minion}}s.
